classification: Exploratory follow-up to an already observed legacy experiment; fixed before new runs, not an untouched preregistration
estimand: Repeated-sample probability that a normal-critical-value interval covers mean zero
initialization: Original implementation: X starts at zero, 100 burn-in steps; finite samples are approximately, not exactly, stationary. All cells retained.
comparison: Same seed within innovation pairs couples the samples for the two bandwidths. The backend does not retain paired indicator counts, so no paired significance claim will be made.
uncertainty: Report empirical Monte Carlo SE and 95% Wilson intervals for each marginal coverage. For simultaneous statements across the 8 extension method-cell coverages, also report Bonferroni-Wilson intervals; these remain approximations.
theory_to_check: For fixed L and stationary AR(1), variance ratio rho_L=1-2*phi*(1-phi^(L+1))/((L+1)*(1-phi^2)); limiting interval coverage is 2*Phi(1.96*sqrt(rho_L))-1. More observations alone do not remove fixed bandwidth truncation bias.
budgets: 10 coverage actions, each at most 120 seconds. No unrecorded retry or selective omission. No claim of real-population validity or research novelty.
